profile.pronunciation_convention: IPA, broad transcription, standard Italian; spoken = stress hint
profile.grammar_notes: Copula essere for identity and description; existence with c'è / ci sono (esserci); stare for how someone is (come stai?) and stare + gerundio for ongoing action. Subject pronouns usually dropped; the verb ending carries the person. Negation with non before the verb. Yes/no questions by intonation only. Polite address with Lei (3rd person singular) vs tu. Modals volere, potere, dovere + infinitive. Past: passato prossimo with avere or essere. Closed sets: subject pronouns, definite articles by gender/number/initial sound, modal set (volere, potere, dovere), clitic pronouns.
